messages:
marie (Docs): opened a docs PR that needs cross-team signoff — adds migration guide for credential rotation + SDK examples. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/788. tagging @ajay @lisa @cal. CI shows checks pending.

ajay (Security): thanks — I'll review. quick q: does the PR include any literal keys or fake tokens in examples? if so we need to scrub them or use placeholders.

marie (Docs): good catch — there was a line `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=abcd1234` in the example. i can change to `export REDWOOD_API_KEY='${REDWOOD_API_KEY}'` or `[REDACTED]`. which do you prefer?

ajay (Security): prefer the `${VAR}` form or explicit `[REDACTED]`. anything that looks like a token triggers scans/alerts. also please request a secret-scan run on the PR.

dev-bot: secret-scan queued for PR 788 -> running -> completed: no findings.

marie (Docs): updated the PR — replaced literal with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY='${REDWOOD_API_KEY}'` and added a small note about not embedding creds. pushed to branch. PTAL.

lisa (Legal): quick legal note: for pages that discuss credentials we need a short paragraph about storage/retention and a reminder to use company-approved secret managers (KMS/SSM). i can supply wording.

lisa (Legal): suggested copy: "Do not store credentials in source or public docs. Use the company-approved secret manager, rotate credentials per policy, and consult Security for high-risk integrations." please add to a new "Handling secrets" subsection.

marie (Docs): added Lisa's paragraph and set `sensitive: true` in the page frontmatter so it won't appear in public lists until approvals are complete. pushed the update.

ajay (Security): nice. also add an example YAML snippet showing the sensitivity flag so our pipeline will skip publish: `sensitive: true`. that helps the docs release process detect gated content.

cal (Eng): tagging docs + security — we're fine with merge after legal signoff. please wait for `ci/docs-preview` to finish though. if merged early we can gate publishing until the next release window.

dev-bot: ci/docs-preview: success — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-788/overview

marie (Docs): thanks! @lisa final signoff when you have a moment? aiming to merge after 13:00 UTC.

lisa (Legal): :white_check_mark: approved. one tiny nit on phrasing (i'll DM it) but nothing blocking. keep the preview link for records.

marie (Docs): merging now. merge commit: `Merge pull request #788 from docs/credential-redact` — CI green. @cal please confirm deploy gating.

cal (Eng): got it — we'll hold public publish until Monday release window and keep the internal preview live. closing loop on my side.

marie (Docs): thanks everyone — leaving a follow-up in the release channel with the final link and Lisa's approved copy for audit.
